Baajik was a Chadra-Fan male who served as a double agent to both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Hutts. In 3 ABY he was killed on Ord Mantell by bounty hunter Cypher Bos.

page.overview:
Who is Baajik?

Baajik was a Chadra-Fan male who served as a double agent to both the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Hutts. In 3 ABY he was killed on Ord Mantell by bounty hunter Cypher Bos.
